cases.name: Lauren Michaela "Mikki" Payne
cases.about:
According to her family, she loved making jewelry, polishing rocks and caring for her cats and chickens. “She’s always been a nice person. She’d come over here and talk to me and she was kind. She was an animal lover; she was a pretty girl,” (neighbor Carolyn) Camby said.

Her obituary said, "She was the sweetest, most loving baby girl and grew into a beautiful, tender-hearted young woman. She was a beautiful soul, a free spirit, and a lover of all animals. She was amazingly creative, had an angelic singing voice, and had the ability to see the beauty in things the rest of us never see. She was fiercely dedicated to animal rescue and that legacy will continue on her behalf for as long as is humanly possible. This world is poorer for having lost her but blessed for having loved her for her short 23 years. Our lives will never be the same. We love you, Girlie. Rest well."
cases.narrative: On 2/15/2023, her body was discovered. She appeared to have been killed Sunday 2/12/2023 in the evening and he lived with her body for some time.
